_comment: Lebanon restaurants/hotels/beach-clubs pitch. User's exact fixed copy, no signal variation. Salutation slot is the only change from the source text. No em-dashes. Renders through email_template.py at send.
subject_template: The messages you can't keep up with
body_template:
Hi {salutation},

Hope business is coming back strong. I've been paying attention to how places like yours handle a normal day, and I've noticed the same thing again and again: the WhatsApp and Instagram inbox fills up with the same questions about menus, hours and bookings, and during service nobody has a free hand to reply. So reservations quietly go to whoever answers first, and with the diaspora coming back, that inbox is about to get much heavier.

I'm David Geha, a third year Engineering student at AUB, and I work with OSG (https://osgdev.com). We're AI consultants: we find where a business is losing time and money and build AI systems around those exact gaps. We've done this for marketing agencies, F&B businesses and oil and gas companies across Lebanon and the GCC.

Could we do a 20 minute call to go through the details? Feel free to call or WhatsApp me directly on +961 76 412 978.

Best,
David Geha
OSG
https://osgdev.com
Instagram: dave.automates
